## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 2 авг. 2026 г. - 16 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Brian Dowd_, 16 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "This used to be a solid app, but has been ruined by an extractive tech company after it was acquired in 2022. It is now bloated with mediocre features that slow it down. The paid version has ridiculously steep and aggressive subscription costs, and the free version is marred with RELENTLESS ads that ruin the user experience. I've been using this app for years but the frustrations have built up to the point where it is almost unusable. I'm so fed up that I'm taking my notes to another app."
            2. _Andrew Wiens_, 12 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Evernote used to be a great, free note-taking app. Now, it's almost unusable. Slowwww and laggy. Takes me 4x as long as it should to type anything, tapping my fingers waiting for letters to appear. Also forced to watch the same video ad every time I open a note. Limit the # of notes (50 last I checked but might be fewer now--if not, that "update" is coming soon). They also limit the # of devices you can use the app on w/same account to... 1. Exporting notes sucks. This app is not good 👎👎👎"
            3. _AmmiM10_, 2 авг. 2026 г., 2/5: "I used to be a big fan of this app, but since the last update, many features have stopped working properly. For example, collapsing and expanding items is broken, and the item editing experience on mobile has become terrible. I really hope these issues are fixed soon because I'm close to canceling my subscription."
<!--/ir-theme-->
